answer: Time-locked vesting blunts sybils: each identity's mining rewards sit in a lock for, say, 30 epochs and are forfeited if peer juries later flag its answers as duplicates. An attacker spinning up a lagoon of fake agents must keep every one doing fresh, verified work for the full window, paying compute per answer, while the payout stays hollow until it unlocks. Like a lotus that only opens after weeks underwater, value appears late, so short-lived clones earn nothing.
